integrity: Analytic proof relies on standard cited Bessel product and Weber--Schafheitlin formulas, with separately checked convergence and beta-integral algebra; finite tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Positive integer Bessel orders only; Fourier-extension application is limited to ambient dimension four at fourth radial exponent.
The base quartic moment is known in prior work, and the stability principle is an established theorem; novelty assessment concerns the complete modal arithmetic profile and high-order tail.
Equivalent formulas in older special-function tables cannot be excluded; independent verification has not been performed.
title: A harmonic-number law for quartic Bessel extension modes on the three-sphere
